messages:
Megan L.: Quick sync — launch plan for hosted / dedicated / private pages. Need three things: 1) two hero headline variants (performance-led vs cost-led), 2) gating strategy (webinar gate vs direct start), 3) inbound lead routing matrix mapping webinar signups -> demo vs self-serve onboarding. Draft plan here: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-launch-plan. Who can own headline + short social hooks?

Samir K.: I can take the headlines and social hooks. My thinking: benchmark narrative should be an opener — "Predictable latency, predictable cost" + a one-liner on model parity. Will write 6 short social captions (two per mode).

Ivy Chen: I'll do hero comps. For the gating UI, recommend dual-CTA pattern: left CTA "Watch 20m webinar" (gated) and right CTA "Start Hosted API" (self-serve). We'll A/B test primary placement.

Drew P.: Routing proposal: webinar -> qualify -> tagged demo request (tags: dedicated-fit, private-fit, hosted-inbound). Direct "Start" -> automation sequence (onboarding emails + sample prompts). I'll add mapping to HubSpot and set up a webhook to our routing zap.

Ava R.: Webinar cadence: 30 min product demo + 10 min AMA. Promo plan: week -2 benchmark post, week -1 customer story, week 0 final push. Email templates coming. Quick subject line drafts:
```
Subject A: See how Acme cut inference cost 3x with Redwood
Subject B: Live: Fast, reliable LLM inference for product teams
```

Megan L.: Nice. @Samir please drop the 6 social captions (short + one-liner) into the doc by EOD. @Drew make sure webinar signups get the right lifecycle stage in HubSpot. @Ivy share figma link when ready.

Ivy Chen: Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/launch-hero. Uploaded first pass (performance-led). Comments welcome — I left alternate mobile layout frames.

comm-bot: Poll: React :one: for performance-led hero, :two: for cost-led hero.

Drew P.: FYI — for private deployments we should swap the webinar gate to an "request demo" enterprise flow (because of NDA / firewall asks). I'll add enterprise form fields.

Megan L.: Great — consolidate copy + routing doc by tomorrow 10am and we'll review in sync. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
